task_instance: Use the nvshmem-docs skill to explain the NVSHMEM_THREAD_SERIALIZED runtime setting for latest NVSHMEM, fetching and citing the official NVIDIA documentation page as the skill requires.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is to open live official NVIDIA NVSHMEM documentation pages over HTTPS and answer only from that retrieved evidence; it explicitly forbids making technical claims from memory, from search snippets, or from the bundled topic map, and says that if live pages cannot be retrieved it must not give documentation-backed answers. The air-gapped runtime grants no network access: DNS resolution of the documentation host failed, and an outbound HTTPS request was refused by the proxy tunnel (403 Forbidden). Additionally, every documentation link in SKILL.md and the topic map was replaced by an unreachable placeholder, so even the target page addresses are not available. A retrieval tool able to open public NVIDIA HTTPS documentation is the one ability the skill names as a prerequisite, and the offline runtime does not provide it.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: Purpose/Prerequisites require a retrieval tool that can open public NVIDIA HTTPS documentation and forbid claims from memory or the topic map (lines 17, 21). Confirmed the required references/topic-map.md is present next to SKILL.md, so skill files are not the blocker. From the work directory, ran python3 -I urllib.request against the public documentation host: failed with 'URLError <urlopen error Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden>'. socket.gethostbyname of the same host failed with no resolution (air-gapped, no DNS). No deliverable could be produced because no live official page could be fetched to cite, and the skill prohibits substituting memory or the routing-only topic map. No files other than result.json were produced in the work directory.
